owner_question: Which workflow, audience and owner decision is this page supporting?
safe_evidence: A named use case, owner and next review step.
stop_rule: Do not imply a full implementation or production result.

owner_question: Can this be reviewed without customer, patient, personal, production, credential or billing data?
safe_evidence: Use synthetic, sample or redacted planning notes only.
stop_rule: Stop before uploading sensitive or live data.

owner_question: Are rankings, leads, revenue, savings, ROI, appointment growth and AI accuracy still unverified?
safe_evidence: Keep claims as hypotheses or review criteria until independently measured.
stop_rule: Do not publish outcome numbers without source evidence.

owner_question: Does a qualified human need to review legal, privacy, security, medical, financial or procurement implications?
safe_evidence: Route specialist decisions to qualified review before action.
stop_rule: Do not treat this guide as professional advice.

owner_question: Is there a no-credentials diagnostic path if the owner wants help?
safe_evidence: Use the linked AICS free review or fixed-scope diagnostic path.
stop_rule: Do not request production access before scope and evidence boundaries are agreed.

owner_question: This checklist is a template for small-business website readiness in India; it is not client proof.
stop_rule: No real client, customer, patient, personal, production, credential, cloud bill, revenue, savings, ROI, ranking, demand, lead, customer, appointment-growth, outcome or AI-accuracy claim.
